exec(open('helpers.py').read())
lab = labels_all(); y = lab[:1024]; folds = make_folds(1024)
m = load('mean',11)
def LN(X): 
    X = X - X.mean(1,keepdims=True); return X/np.sqrt((X**2).mean(1,keepdims=True)+1e-12)
lams=(0.05,0.1,0.2,0.4)
print('m', ridge_cv(m,y,lams,folds))
print('LN(m)', ridge_cv(LN(m),y,lams,folds))
# PCA compression
mc = m - m.mean(0); U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(mc, full_matrices=False)
print('var explained', [(k, round((S[:k]**2).sum()/(S**2).sum(),4)) for k in [64,128,256,384,512]])
for k in [128,256,384,512]:
    Z = mc@Vt[:k].T
    print('pca',k, ridge_cv(Z,y,lams,folds))
# no-standardize ridge (raw)
